title: How research funding took me out of the lab and into leadership
title_zh: 科研经费如何让我离开实验室，走向领导岗位
abstract: Landing two large grants caused Anna Sandak to take on a managerial role in her team and made her reflect on what it means to contribute to research.
abstract_zh: 获得两项大型资助促使安娜·桑达克（Anna Sandak）在团队中担任管理职务，并让她反思为科研做出贡献的意义。
snippet: Landing two large grants caused Anna Sandak to take on a managerial role in her team and made her reflect on what it means to contribute to research.
